content.value: A continuous aligned glass fiber-reinforced composite consists of 30% volume of glass fibers (10) having an elastic modulus of 65 GPa and 60% volume of an epoxy resin that, when harden, has an elastic modulus of 4 GPa. If the cross-sectional area of the composite is 250 mm² and a stress of 50 MPa is applied in the direction of fiber alignment then,
(i) Compute the elastic modulus of the composite in longitudinal and transverse direction.
(ii) Determîne the strain in each phase of composite and also the stress in each phase of composite.
